paragraphs: ConceptLens is a modern course notes concept extractor and study assistant. It ingests course notes as PDFs (both digital and scanned), images (scanned notes & photos), or text documents, and extracts key academic concepts, definitions, and relational knowledge using the official Google Gemini AI API (google-genai), with an ultra-lightweight offline fallback (PyMuPDF + YAKE).
features: PDF (Digital & Scanned): Direct multimodal extraction via Gemini Vision. Handles scanned documents, handwritten annotations, and multi-column layouts without memory crashes.
Images (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP): Direct photo & scan comprehension for handwritten notebooks and whiteboards.

requirements.text: No separate login/signup page: The login and registration experience lives embedded directly inside the dashboard and can be toggled as a modal or mobile bottom sheet from the header.
When signed out, the dashboard displays the embedded "Sign in to your workspace" card, and document uploads/history are locked.
